errors: OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device while writing .demo/postgres-startup.log
interpretation: Storage exhaustion was observed in the failed universal devcontainer. Recovery uses a different container and has available workspace storage; the original failing filesystem could not be inspected after recovery.
fix_under_test: Smaller Ubuntu 24.04 development image with Python 3.12 and Docker-in-Docker 4.1.3; no universal image or inherited Yarn apt source. Preserve failure diagnostics without masking the original Compose error.
